entities.name: Glimmer
entities.description: Light manifestations of the hopes and persistence of Duskmourn's survivors that protect against Valgavoth's malice.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The malicious force of the House that glimmers protect against.

events.summary: Glimmers can be extinguished when their companion loses hope or dies.
events.quote: They can be extinguished when their companion loses hope or dies

relations.note: Glimmers offer protection against his malice.
relations.quote: Glimmers offer magical protection against Valgavoth ’s insidious malice
